verdict.rationale: Docs show a clear API-driven account opening flow (Person → Business → Account Application) with KYC/KYB integration, plus a Developer Sandbox with API keys and Postman collection for pre-launch testing (treasury-prime-docs-4, treasury-prime-docs-5, treasury-prime-docs-1, treasury-prime-docs-12). However, there is no explicit documentation confirming FDIC/NCUA deposit insurance status or an end-to-end 'application to active account' status confirmation step, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of sandbox-to-production parity. Missing for 10: explicit insured-deposit language, documented account-activation/status lifecycle, and third-party verification of sandbox parity.
